questions.question: A New Testament letter says husbands who refuse to believe the word can be won over by their wives. How?

answers.text: Without words by how their wives live
By hearing their wives preach to them
By a visit from the church elders

questions.question: A New Testament letter tells women that beauty should not come from braided hair, gold or fine clothes. Where should it come from?

answers.text: The inner disposition of the heart
The good reputation of the family
The steady labor of the hands

questions.question: A New Testament letter says the way a husband treats his wife has nothing to do with his prayers. True or false?
